record.question: The Chief Election Commissioner of India can be removed from office during his tenure by
options: the Chief Justice of India if some charges are proved against him
the President on the basis of a resolution of the Union Cabinet
a committee consisting of Chief Justice of India, Law Minister of India and the Vice President of India
the President on the basis of resolution passed by the Parliament by two-thirds majority
record.explanation: The Chief Election Commissioner is removed in the same manner as a Supreme Court judge: by the President on an address supported by the special majority of Parliament.
